messages:
anya: quick check — procurement just confirmed a tuck-in shipment of 8 A100s to eu-west1 for the demo next Tue. do we have quota to backfill into the dedicated pool or should we spin up a short-lived burst pool?

mike: do we know which zone? eu-west1-b or -c? quota is zonal for GPUs.

anya: vendor said eu-west1-b. they can route to another zone if needed but prefer that one.

lee: i just pulled the project quotas, looks like project-prod has 4/12 A100 in eu-west1-b used. current request would exceed by 4.

sophia: can we borrow from demo-project temporarily? demo-project has 0/8 used in that zone. last time we moved GPUs we opened ticket with GCP support.

mike: opened internal ticket INF-3421 to request temporary quota bump and cross-project migration plan. pinged quotas@gcp. attaching quick check command i used:

```
$ gcloud compute regions describe europe-west1 --project=project-prod --format="json(quotas)"
# grep for "A100"
```

anya: thanks. if quota bump is slow, can we create a small dedicated burst pool in eu-west1-c with 8 A100 and put the demo on that? longer-term we want these in dedicated-prod but demo can tolerate short-lived.

nisha (vendor): vendor can stage racks in eu-west1-c instead and push tomorrow evening if that helps. will need final zone confirmed by 10:00 UTC.

lee: action items per INF-3421: 1) mike to follow up with GCP quota contact (done, awaiting reply), 2) sophia to validate cross-project VPN and auth for temporary borrow, 3) anya to confirm demo schedule and accept zone change if needed.

infra-oncall-bot: auto-note: if quota bump approved, schedule env migration during off-peak window (22:00-02:00 UTC) to limit impact.

anya: i'll confirm demo can shift to eu-west1-c if vendor pushes. mike — can you drop updates here as soon as GCP responds? :thumbsup:

mike: will do. if no reply by EOD i'll escalate to account manager.

sophia: i'll start a dry-run checklist for cross-project attach (IAM roles, subnet peering, NVLink config reminders).

anya: perfect, thanks everyone.
